newsitem.title: USA: Kollmorgen forming new co from Macbeth unit.
newsitem.headline: Kollmorgen forming new co from Macbeth unit.

text.p: Kollmorgen Corp said Thursday it has signed an agreement with Swiss firm Gretag AG to combine Kollmorgen's Macbeth color instruments business with Gretag's Color Control Systems division.

Kollmorgen said each company will have the same number of directors on the board of the new company, GretagMacbeth Holdings AG. Kollmorgen said it will own 48 percent of GretagMacbeth shares and Gretag will own the remaining 52 percent.
The deal should be completed in the first quarter, and a public offering of GretagMacbeth shares will be made to European investors through the Swiss Stock Exchange later this year, Kollmorgen said.

"This transaction is expected to have a positive effect on Kollmorgen's earnings in 1997," the company said in a release. "In addition, Kollmorgen expects its financial position will be strengthened significantly if its equity position in GretagMacbeth is sold in the Swiss offering.
Kollmorgen said combined revenues of the two businesses were about $57 million in 1996.
